register.labelZh: BANG 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: bang around、bang about 和 bang away 可以描述有人走動、搬東西或不停敲打而發出很大聲響。；bang away at something 可以表示某人長時間努力處理一項工作。；bang on about something 可以表示某人不斷重提同一話題,令人感到厭煩。；bang out 可以描述大聲有力的演奏;bang into、bang up 和 bang down 則可以描述不同形式的碰撞或撞擊。
register.summaryEn: Bang around, bang about and bang away help you describe people moving things or striking objects noisily. Bang away at something shows that a person continues working hard at a task for some time. Bang on about something is useful when a person keeps returning to the same subject and becomes annoying. Bang out describes loud energetic music, while bang into, bang up and bang down describe different kinds of physical impact.

questions.targetMeaningZh: 用樂器大聲而有力地奏出樂曲

questions.prompt: Although the hammering had annoyed everyone, the builder continued striking until the loose board was fixed.
questions.promptZh: 雖然敲打聲令所有人感到煩厭,建築工人仍繼續敲打,直至把鬆脫的木板修好。
questions.answer: Although the hammering had annoyed everyone, the builder continued banging away until the loose board was fixed.
questions.answerZh: 雖然敲打聲令所有人感到煩厭,建築工人仍繼續不停敲打,直至把鬆脫的木板修好。
questions.targetMeaningZh: 不停地敲打,發出很大聲響
